project(compiler)
add_executable(${PROJECT_NAME})
init_project(${PROJECT_NAME})

target_sources(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
	"source/main.cpp"
	"source/lexer.hpp"
	"source/lexer.cpp"
	"source/error.hpp"
	"source/error.cpp"
	"source/parser.hpp"
	"source/parser.cpp"
	"source/util.hpp"
	"source/util.cpp"
	"source/types.hpp"
	"source/types.cpp"
	"source/compiler.hpp"
	"source/compiler.cpp"
	"source/ast/ast.hpp"
)

# Embed the runtime library, so the compiler is a single self-contained executable.
set(RUNTIME_SOURCE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/runtime/runtime.c")
set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${RUNTIME_SOURCE}")
file(READ "${RUNTIME_SOURCE}" RUNTIME_DATA)
string(LENGTH "${RUNTIME_DATA}" RUNTIME_LENGTH)
set(RUNTIME_HEADER "// Generated by CMake from runtime/runtime.c, do not edit.
#pragma once
namespace blitz {
	inline const char* const runtime_source =
")
set(RUNTIME_OFFSET 0)
while(RUNTIME_OFFSET LESS RUNTIME_LENGTH)
	# Compilers limit the size of a single string literal, so split into many smaller ones.
	string(SUBSTRING "${RUNTIME_DATA}" ${RUNTIME_OFFSET} 8000 RUNTIME_CHUNK)
	string(APPEND RUNTIME_HEADER "R\"BBRT(${RUNTIME_CHUNK})BBRT\"
")
	math(EXPR RUNTIME_OFFSET "${RUNTIME_OFFSET} + 8000")
endwhile()
string(APPEND RUNTIME_HEADER ";
}
")
file(CONFIGURE OUTPUT "${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}/runtime_source.hpp" CONTENT "${RUNTIME_HEADER}" @ONLY NEWLINE_STYLE UNIX)
target_include_directories(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
	"${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/source"
	"${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}"
)

get_target_property(_SOURCES ${PROJECT_NAME} SOURCES)
source_group(TREE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} FILES ${_SOURCES})


# Tests: every program in /tests has to compile into an executable, the lexer test only has to lex.
enable_testing()
set(TEST_DIRECTORY "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/../tests")
foreach(_TEST IN ITEMS 001 002 003 004)
	add_test(
		NAME "compile-${_TEST}"
		COMMAND ${PROJECT_NAME} "${TEST_DIRECTORY}/${_TEST}.bb" -o "${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}/test-${_TEST}${CMAKE_EXECUTABLE_SUFFIX}"
	)
endforeach()
add_test(
	NAME "lex-test"
	COMMAND ${PROJECT_NAME} --dump-tokens "${TEST_DIRECTORY}/test.bb"
)
